title: Members
ownerNote: Owner is changed only by transfer (Settings › Lifecycle).
removeBody: {n, plural, =0 {No open tasks are assigned to {first}.} one {# open task assigned to {first} becomes Unassigned (listed in Tasks › Unassigned).} other {# open tasks assigned to {first} become Unassigned (listed in Tasks › Unassigned).}} {first} keeps nothing from this project in Personal; projections disappear.
leaveBody: {n, plural, =0 {You have no open tasks here.} one {Your # open task becomes Unassigned.} other {Your # open tasks become Unassigned.}} Their projections leave your Personal tasks and calendar.
lastOwner: The Owner can’t leave; transfer ownership first (Settings › Lifecycle).

guide.title: Roles
guide.owner: Everything, incl. delete and transfer. Exactly one.
guide.admin: Settings, members, workflow. Cannot change the Owner.
guide.manager: Plan, assign, edit any task, risks, milestones.
guide.member: Work on tasks, create tasks, comment, upload.
guide.guest: Verified external person; only granted tasks + shared files.

pendingUnavailable: Pending invitations cannot be listed yet. Invitations you send still reach people.
grantsUnavailable: Task-only guests cannot be listed yet.
